verses.geez: ለየአወይዋ፡ አሕማረ፡ ኬልቄዶን፡ እስመ፡ ተሐጕለ፡ ወኢያመጽኡ፡ እንከ፡ እምብሔረ፡ ኬጤዎን፡ ወያመጽእዎሙ፡ ፄዋ።
verses.translation: The Word concerning Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Carthage; for she has perished, and men no longer arrive from the land of the Citians: she is led captive.

translations.lxx: The Word concerning Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Carthage; for she has perished, and men no longer arrive from the land of the Citians: she is led captive.
translations.kjv: The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.
translations.ron: Tânguiţi-vă voi, corăbii ale Tarsisului, căci limanul vostru a fost nimicit. Venitu-le-a această ştire din ţara Chitim.
translations.grk: Ὀλολύξατε, πλοῖα Καρχηδόνος, ὅτι ἀπώλετο, καὶ οὐκέτι ἔρχονται ἐκ γῆς Κιτιαίων, ἦκται αἰχμάλωτος.

verses.geez: ምንተ፡ ይመስሉ፡ እለ፡ ይነብሩ፡ ደሴተ፡ ፈላስያን፡ እምፊንቄስ፣፡ እለ፡ ዐደዉ፡ ባሕረ፡ ማይ፡ ብዙኅ።
verses.translation: To whom are the dwellers in the island become like, the merchants of Phœnice, passing over the sea

translations.lxx: To whom are the dwellers in the island become like, the merchants of Phœnice, passing over the sea
translations.kjv: Be still, ye inhabitants of the isle; thou whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.
translations.ron: Amuţiţi voi, locuitori ai coastei pe care o umpleau neguţătorii din Sidon care străbăteau marea!
translations.grk: Τίνι ὅμοιοι γεγόνασιν οἱ ἐνοικοῦντες ἐν τῇ νήσῳ, μετάβολοι Φοινίκης, διαπερῶντες τὴν θάλασσαν

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ዘርእ፡ ዘይትዌለጥ፡ አመ፡ ማእረር፡ እለ፡ ቦኡ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ፈላስያን።
verses.translation: in great waters, a generation of merchants? as when the harvest is gathered in, so are these traders with the nations.

translations.lxx: in great waters, a generation of merchants? as when the harvest is gathered in, so are these traders with the nations.
translations.kjv: And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river, is her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.
translations.ron: Veniturile lui erau grâul Nilului, secerişul din valea lui, adus pe ape mari; el era târgul neamurilor.
translations.grk: ἐν ὕδατι πολλῷ, σπέρμα μετάβολων; ὡς ἀμητοῦ εἰσφερομένου, οἱ μεταβόλοι τῶν ἐθνῶν.

verses.geez: ተኀፈሪ፡ ሲዶና፡ ትቤ፡ ባሕር፤ ወትቤ፡ ኀይለ፡ ባሕር፤ ኢሐመምኩ፡ ወኢወለድኩ፡ ወኢያወርዘውኩ፣፡ ወኢያልሀቁ፡ ደናግለ።
verses.translation: Be ashamed, O Sidon: the sea has said, yea, the strength of the sea has said, I have not travailed, nor brought forth, nor have I brought up young men, nor reared virgins.

translations.lxx: Be ashamed, O Sidon: the sea has said, yea, the strength of the sea has said, I have not travailed, nor brought forth, nor have I brought up young men, nor reared virgins.
translations.kjv: Be thou ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea hath spoken, even the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men, nor bring up virgins.
translations.ron: Ruşinează-te, Sidonule, că marea îţi zice: "Tu n-ai avut dureri de mamă, tu n-ai născut şi nici n-ai crescut băieţi şi nici n-ai ridicat fete".
translations.grk: αἰσχύνθητι Σιδὼν, εἶπεν ἡ θάλασσα· ἡ δὲ ἰσχὺς τῆς θαλάσσης εἶπεν, οὐκ ὤδινον, οὐδὲ ἔτεκον, οὐδὲ ἐξέθρεψα νεανίσκους, οὐδὲ ὕψωσα παρθένους.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ እምከመ፡ ተሰምዐ፡ በግብጽ፣፡ ይእኅዞሙ፡ ሕማማ፡ ለጢሮስ።
verses.translation: Moreover when it shall be heard in Egypt, sorrow shall seize them for Tyre.

translations.lxx: Moreover when it shall be heard in Egypt, sorrow shall seize them for Tyre.
translations.kjv: As at the report concerning Egypt, so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.
translations.ron: Când Egiptul va prinde de veste, va tremura la auzul nenorocirilor Tirului.
translations.grk: Ὅταν δὲ ἀκουστὸν γένηται Αἰγύπτῳ, λήμψεται αὐτοὺς ὀδύνη περὶ Τύρου.

verses.geez: ሖሩ፡ ኬልቄዶን፡ ወየአወይዉ፡ ላቲ፡ እለ፡ ይነብሩ፡ ውስተ፡ ደሴት።
verses.translation: Depart ye to Carthage; howl, ye that dwell in this island.

translations.lxx: Depart ye to Carthage; howl, ye that dwell in this island.
translations.kjv: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.
translations.ron: Treceţi în Tarsis, bociţi-vă, voi, locuitori de pe ţărmuri!
translations.grk: Ἀπέλθατε εἰς Καρχηδόνα, ὀλολύξατε οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν τῇ νήσῳ ταύτῃ.

verses.geez: ዛቲ፡ እንከ፡ ኢኮነትኑ፡ እንቲአክሙ፡ እምትካት፡ ጽዕለተ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ያስተጋብእዋ።
verses.translation: Was not this your pride from the beginning, before she was given up?

translations.lxx: Was not this your pride from the beginning, before she was given up?
translations.kjv: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.
translations.ron: Aceasta este, oare, cetatea voastră de petrecere, a cărei obârşie se urcă în vremuri vechi şi care îşi călăuzea paşii spre sălaşuri depărtate?
translations.grk: Οὐχ αὕτη ἦν ὑμῶν ἡ ὕβρις ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς, πρινὴ παραδοθῆναι αὐτήν;

verses.geez: መኑ፡ ከመዝ፡ አምከረ፡ ላዕለ፡ ጢሮስ፤ ቦኑ፡ ይእቲ፡ ኢትኄይስ፡ ወቦኑ፡ ኢትክል፤ ሠያጢያኒሃ፡ ክቡራን፡ መላእክተ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: Who has devised this counsel against Tyre? Is she inferior? or has she no strength? her merchants were the glorious princes of the earth.

translations.lxx: Who has devised this counsel against Tyre? Is she inferior? or has she no strength? her merchants were the glorious princes of the earth.
translations.kjv: Who hath taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning city, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honourable of the earth?
translations.ron: Cine a poruncit acest lucru împotriva Tirului cel încercat, ai cărui neguţători erau prinţi şi ai cărui vânzători erau cei mari ai pământului?
translations.grk: Τίς ταῦτα ἐβούλευσεν ἐπὶ Τύρον; μὴ ἥσσων ἐστίν, ἢ οὐκ ἰσχύει; οἱ ἔμποροι αὐτῆς ἔνδοξοι ἄρχοντες τῆς γῆς.

verses.geez: እግዚአብሔር፡ ጸባኦት፡ መከረ፡ ይሥዐር፡ ኵሎ፡ ትዕቢቶሙ፡ ለክቡራን፡ ወየኀሥሮሙ፡ ለኵሎሙ፡ ዓበይተ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: The Lord of hosts has purposed to bring down all the pride of the glorious ones, and to disgrace every glorious thing on the earth.

translations.lxx: The Lord of hosts has purposed to bring down all the pride of the glorious ones, and to disgrace every glorious thing on the earth.
translations.kjv: The LORD of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, and to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth.
translations.ron: Domnul Savaot a hotărât aceasta, ca să veştejească mândria a tot ce străluceşte, să smerească pe toţi cei mari ai pământului.
translations.grk: Κύριος σαβαὼθ ἐβουλεύσατο παραλῦσαι πᾶσαν τὴν ὕβριν τῶν ἐνδόξων, καὶ ἀτιμάσαι πᾶν ἔνδοξον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

verses.geez: ተገበር፡ ምድረከ፡ እስመ፡ ኢይመጽኣ፡ እንከ፡ አሕማር፡ እምኬልቄዶን።
verses.translation: Till thy land; for ships no more come out of Carthage.

translations.lxx: Till thy land; for ships no more come out of Carthage.
translations.kjv: Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: there is no more strength.
translations.ron: Treci şi du-te în pământul tău, tu fiică a Tarsisului, căci portul tău nu mai este.
translations.grk: Ἐργάζου τὴν γῆν σου, καὶ γὰρ πλοῖα οὐκέτι ἔρχεται ἐκ Καρχηδόνος.

verses.geez: ወትደክም፡ እንከ፡ እዴከ፡ እንተ፡ መንገለ፡ ባሕር፣፡ እንተ፡ አምዕዐቶሙ፡ ለነገሥት።
verses.translation: And thy hand prevails no more by sea, which troubled kings: the Lord of hosts has given a command concerning Chanaan, to destroy the strength thereof.

translations.lxx: And thy hand prevails no more by sea, which troubled kings: the Lord of hosts has given a command concerning Chanaan, to destroy the strength thereof.
translations.kjv: He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: the LORD hath given a commandment against the merchant city, to destroy the strong holds thereof.
translations.ron: El a întins mâna spre mare, a doborât regatele. Domnul a hotărât împotriva lui Canaan ruina întărituri lor lui.
translations.grk: Ἡ δὲ χείρ σου οὐκέτι ἰσχύει κατὰ θάλασσαν, ἡ παροξύνουσα βασιλεῖς· Κύριος σαβαὼθ ἐνετείλατο περὶ Χαναὰν ἀπολέσαι αὐτῆς τὴν ἰσχύν.

verses.geez: ወይብሉ፤ ኢትደግሙ፡ እንከ፡ ወኢተዐምፅዋ፡ ለወለተ፡ ጽዮን፤ ወእመኒ፡ ሖርከ፡ ብሔረ፡ ኬጤዎን፡ በህየኒ፡ ኢተዐርፍ።
verses.translation: And men shall say, Ye shall no longer at all continue to insult and injure the daughter of Sidon: and if thou depart to the Citians, neither there shalt thou have rest.

translations.lxx: And men shall say, Ye shall no longer at all continue to insult and injure the daughter of Sidon: and if thou depart to the Citians, neither there shalt thou have rest.
translations.kjv: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Chittim; there also shalt thou have no rest.
translations.ron: El a zis: "Nu tresălta de bucurie, tu, fecioară necinstită a Sidonului! Scoală-te şi du-te la Chitim, dar nici acolo nu vei avea odihnă!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐροῦσιν, οὐκέτι οὐ μὴ προστεθῆτε τοῦ ὑβρίζειν καὶ ἀδικεῖν τὴν θυγατέρα Σιδῶνος· καὶ ἐὰν ἀπέλθῃς εἰς Κιτιεῖς, οὐδὲ ἐκεῖ ἀνάπαυσις ἔσται σοι·

verses.geez: አስመ፡ ለብሔረ፡ ከልዴዎንሂ፡ አማሰንዋ፡ ፋርስ፡ ወወድቀ፡ አረፋቲሃ።
verses.translation: And if thou depart to the land of the Chaldeans, this also is laid waste by the Assyrians, for her wall is fallen.

translations.lxx: And if thou depart to the land of the Chaldeans, this also is laid waste by the Assyrians, for her wall is fallen.
translations.kjv: Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, till the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; and he brought it to ruin.
translations.ron: Iată ţara Caldeilor! Acest popor nu sunt Asirienii; El a dat-o pradă fiarelor de câmp. Ei şi-au înălţat turnuri, au dărâmat palate, făcut-au totul o ruină.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰς γῆν Χαλδαίων, καὶ αὕτη ἠρήμωται ἀπὸ τῶν Ἀσσυρίων, ὅτι ὁ τοῖχος αὐτῆς πέπτωκεν.

verses.geez: አውይዋ፡ አሕማረ፡ ዴልቄዶን፡ እስመ፡ ተሰብረ፡ ጸወንክሙ።
verses.translation: Howl, ye ships of Carthage: for your strong hold is destroyed.

translations.lxx: Howl, ye ships of Carthage: for your strong hold is destroyed.
translations.kjv: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.
translations.ron: Bociţi-vă voi, corăbii ale Tarsisului, căci portul vostru a fost dărâmat.
translations.grk: Ὀλολύξατε πλοῖα Καρχηδόνος, ὅτι ἀπόλωλε τὸ ὀχύρωμα ὑμῶν.

verses.geez: ወይእተ፡ አሚር፡ ትነብር፡ ጢሮስ፡ ሰብዓ፡ ዓመተ፡ መጠነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ወመጠነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሰብእ፤ ወእምድኅረ፡ ሰንዓ፡ ዓመት፡ ትከውን፡ ጢሮስ፡ ከመ፡ ማኅሌት፡ ዘዘማ።
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be left seventy years, as the time of a king, as the time of a man: and it shall come to pass after seventy years, that Tyre shall be as the song of a harlot.

translations.lxx: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be left seventy years, as the time of a king, as the time of a man: and it shall come to pass after seventy years, that Tyre shall be as the song of a harlot.
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot.
translations.ron: Şi va fi în ziua aceea că Tirul va fi uitat şaptezeci de ani, ca în zilele unui singur rege, şi la sfârşitul celor şaptezeci de ani Tirul va fi aşa cum se află în cântecul desfrânatei:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ, καταλειφθήσεται Τύρος ἔτη ἑβδομήκοντα, ὡς χρόνος βασιλέως, ὡς χρόνος ἀνθρώπου· καὶ ἔσται μετὰ ἑβδομήκοντα ἔτη, ἔσται Τύρος ὡς ᾆσμα πόρνης.

verses.geez: ንሥኢ፡ መሰንቆ፡ ወዑዲ፡ ሀገረ፡ ዘማ፡ እንተ፡ ተረስዐት፡ ሠናየ፡ ሰንቅዊ፡ ወብዙኀ፡ ኅልዪ፡ ከመ፡ ይዝክሩኪ።
verses.translation: Take a harp, go about, O city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; play well on the harp, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.

translations.lxx: Take a harp, go about, O city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; play well on the harp, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.
translations.kjv: Take an harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.
translations.ron: Ia chitara, dă ocol cetăţii, tu, desfrânată! Cântă cât mai bine, reia cântările ca lumea să-şi aducă aminte de tine!
translations.grk: Λάβε κιθάραν, ῥέμβευσον πόλις πόρνη ἐπιλελησμένη, καλῶς κιθάρισον, πολλὰ ᾆσον, ἵνα σου μνεία γένηται.

verses.geez: ወእምድኅረ፡ ሰብዓ፡ ዓመት፡ ይሔውጻ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለጢሮስ፡ ወትገብእ፡ ካዕበ፡ ከመ፡ ትካት፣፡ ወትከውን፡ ምቅዳሐ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ነገሥተ፡ ዓለም፡ ላዕለ፡ ገጸ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass after the seventy years, that God will visit Tyre, and she shall be again restored to her primitive state, and she shall be a mart for all the kingdoms of the world on the face of the earth.

translations.lxx: And it shall come to pass after the seventy years, that God will visit Tyre, and she shall be again restored to her primitive state, and she shall be a mart for all the kingdoms of the world on the face of the earth.
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that the LORD will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire, and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.
translations.ron: Şi după cei şaptezeci de ani, Domnul va cerceta iarăşi cetatea Tirului şi ea va reîncepe să primească preţul desfrâului ei. Ea se va desfrâna pentru toate regatele lumii de pe faţa pământului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται μετὰ τὰ ἑβδομήκοντα ἔτη, ἐπισκοπὴν ποιήσει ὁ Θεὸς Τύρου, καὶ πάλιν ἀποκαταστήσεται εἰς τὸ ἀρχαῖον, καὶ ἔσται ἐμπόριον πάσαις ταῖς βασιλείαις τῆς οἰκουμένης ἐπὶ πρόσωπον τῆς γῆς.

verses.geez: ወትከውን፡ መስተገብረ፡ ወዕሤተ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ቅዱስ፤ ወአኮ፡ ለእሙንቱ፡ ዘይትጋብኡ፡ ዳእሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ይነብሩ፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፤ ወኵሉ፡ ተግባራ፡ ለበሊዕ፡ ወለሰቲይ፡ ወለጸጊብ፡ ወታጸግብ፡ ተዝካራ፡ በቅድመ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: And her trade and her gain shall be holiness to the Lord: it shall not be gathered for them, but for those that dwell before the Lord, even all her trade, to eat and drink and be filled, and for a covenant and a memorial before the Lord.

translations.lxx: And her trade and her gain shall be holiness to the Lord: it shall not be gathered for them, but for those that dwell before the Lord, even all her trade, to eat and drink and be filled, and for a covenant and a memorial before the Lord.
translations.kjv: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the LORD: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
translations.ron: Dar tot câştigul, toate foloasele ei vor fi afierosite Domnului şi nu vor fi adunate, nici puse la păstrare; ci câştigul va fi pentru cei ce locuiesc înaintea Domnului, ca să aibă hrană din belşug şi haine strălucite.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται αὐτῆς ἡ ἐμπορία καὶ ὁ μισθὸς ἅγιον Κυρίῳ· οὐκ αὐτοῖς συναχθήσεται, ἀλλὰ τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν ἔναντι Κυρίου, πᾶσα ἡ ἐμπορία αὐτῆς, φαγεῖν καὶ πιεῖν καὶ ἐμπλησθῆναι, καὶ εἰς συμβολὴν μνημόσυνον ἔναντι Κυρίου.
